label: STRC drawdown — apxUSD depeg low ~$0.89 (−1,059 bps), unresolved
note: 2026-06-02 — STRC (Strategy preferred equity, ~62% of reserve) traded below par as Bitcoin fell, dragging apxUSD's reserve value; the incident opened on June 2 at ~$0.99 and drove a recorded low of ~$0.89 (−1,059 bps). It did not mean-revert: still active as of mid-June 2026 (~$0.96). CoinDesk reported it on June 4, with Apyx framing it as expected behavior for a preferred-equity-backed dollar.
